Room.title: WNI Simulator Multiplayer Room
Room.description: Represents a multiplayer room supporting 4 to 64 players in WNI Simulator: Bertahan Hidup di Negeri Konoha.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room host.

hostName.description: Display nickname of the room host.

gameState.description: Current game phase state (WAITING or PLAYING).

hostId.description: Player numeric ID of the room host.

maxPlayers.description: Maximum player capacity for the room (4 to 64).

activePlayerIndex.description: Index of the player whose turn is currently active.

stateTreasury.description: Total Kas Negara balance in Rupiah.

isExtremeMusibahActive.description: Whether State Escalation (Musibah Ekstrem) is active.

players.description: Bounded list of up to 64 players in the room.

memberUids.description: Bounded list of Firebase Auth UIDs (<=128 chars) of human members, without bots. Source of truth for write-permission membership checks in firestore.rules; monotonically grows via the join path only.

properties.description: Map of board tile IDs to property ownership and building state.

loans.description: Bounded list of active player-to-player loans.

activityLogs.description: Bounded list of recent game activity logs.

customAssets.description: Synchronized custom images (pawns, 3D buildings, board center logo) configured by the room host.

durationMode.description: Host-selected game duration mode, synchronized so every client shows the same HUD and end screen.

gameOverReason.description: Reason the game ended (round limit, wealth target, or last player standing).

pendingMoneyRequest.description: Active player-to-player money request awaiting the target player's accept/reject decision.

pendingLoanProposal.description: Active player-to-player loan proposal awaiting the lender's approval and interest rate.

sharedFateCard.description: Takdir/Musibah card currently drawn by the active player, synchronized so every client can watch the event read-only.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last updated.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Stores real-time state for multiplayer WNI Simulator rooms.
